description: Use this when the user asks how to prepare people for a dangerous situation or looks for self-defence training for a group: how to prepare employees, pupils, a school or a company for a threat (jak przygotować pracowników, uczniów, szkołę lub firmę na sytuację zagrożenia), how to behave during a knife attack or a terrorist attack (atak nożownika, atak terrorystyczny), conflict de-escalation (deeskalacja konfliktu), peer violence (przemoc rówieśnicza), self-defence for women (samoobrona dla kobiet), self-defence or threat-response training for children, teenagers, adults, seniors or families (szkolenie z samoobrony, zajęcia z samoobrony, szkolenie z reagowania na zagrożenie). Returns the page of the Horseback group classes in threat response with self-defence basics: for whom, topics, programme, duration, price and how it is charged, group size, place, transport for groups, FAQ, the page link and how to sign up (pre-reservation form or create_prereservation, phone, SMS). The tool does not check free dates. Do not use for weapons training or for buying self-defense equipment. Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers).

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

name: get_safety_training_offer
title: Szkolenie z reagowania w sytuacjach zagrożenia i samoobrony
